system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Mercenary, Berserker, or Avenger.

If the target of the attack is either either [Staggered], [Dazed], [Decay], or [Confusion], and receives at least one point of damage, they gain the [Afflicted] tag.

A special skill that doesn't miss when the enemy flinched and launches a follow-up attack. On the battlefield, those who show an opening will disappear. This technique is a symbol of that iron rule.
